name: MLentory
description: MLentory is an NFDI4DataScience registry for discovering machine learning models and related artifacts. It aggregates metadata from repositories such as Hugging Face and OpenML through an ETL pipeline, harmonises descriptions using FAIR4ML and Croissant ML, and exposes Webby FAIR Digital Objects (FDOs) with schema.org metadata, RO-Crate packaging, and FAIR Signposting. The system provides a REST API, RDF knowledge graph, Elasticsearch indexing, and a Vue.js front-end with natural-language search refined by retrieval-augmented generation. At ZB MED, the Semantic Technologies team develops MLentory, contributes to lightweight FDO implementations on GitHub Pages, and engages in community events including CoRDI, KI2025 tutorials, the FDO Implementation Summit, and the de.NBI BioHackathon on semantics and large language models.
